title: security (v19 major): View All / Modify All stop voting on fields — ADR-0087 conversion adds `viewAllFields: true` beside them, `superuserFieldVote` and `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` retire (step 3 of #34365, behaviour change)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzFAE8YRsK8YCDAeLL

Filing gate: ④ sub-card of the ruled decision #34365 (ruling 6912661484, verbatim 「同意，立决策卡」; implementation cards are cut after PR #34082, merged 2026-11-16T21:40Z) · Source: topic #34365

Parent: #34365 (step 3, "v19 major")
Blocked-by: #36050, #36052
Grade: left to triage. Suggested **p2** (the end state of the p2 security card #34365). Area: data. Type suggestion: Feature.
⛔ **Behaviour change in a major.** Ships only in the v19 major, and is built only after the maintainer's go-ahead through the seat (this card's parent ruling sets the end state, not the build start).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue viewAllFields` → 3 hits: #34365 (the parent), #33828 (closed), #6015 (triage seat post). No card covers this step.

## Business reason

This is the step that fixes the defect class for good: one set's View All / Modify All will no longer re-open a field another set hides (hotcrm#2481's class). Every mainstream platform the parent card checked (Salesforce, Dataverse, ServiceNow, Odoo) keeps the record-wide bit off the field axis, and Salesforce added a separate read-only "View All Fields" for the same reason. The conversion keeps every existing app's behaviour verbatim, so no app owner loses access at upgrade.

## What to build

- `viewAllRecords` and `modifyAllRecords` cast **no field vote**: retire `superuserFieldVote` as a field-vote source (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`) in both merges (`getFieldPermissions`, `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions`), leaving `viewAllFields` as the only "all fields" channel. Readers of `superuserFieldVote` outside the merges (e.g. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts`) move to the new reading.
- One ADR-0087 mechanical conversion (`packages/spec/src/conversions/entries/19/`): add `viewAllFields: true` to every `objects` entry (wildcard included) that carries `viewAllRecords` or `modifyAllRecords` and does not already say `viewAllFields`. Behaviour kept verbatim; authors remove the bit where it isn't wanted.
- One semantic upgrade-guide entry (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`). After conversion, the only remaining behaviour change is "Modify All plus the same set's own `editable: false` / `readable: false` row" — the entry names it, and the lint that already names that case is its pointer.
- Retire `security-superuser-field-mask-inert` (`packages/lint`), and re-point the cross-set warning from the step-2 lint sub-card (it no longer fires for View All / Modify All after the switch) — the PR says what that rule becomes.
- ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ end-state note (governed, Tier H).
- File the hotcrm follow-up when this lands: convert `sales_manager` (which relies on Modify All to read account roll-ups) from the converted `viewAllFields: true` to explicit rows (#34365 step 4).

## Declarations the PR owes

`Clause-②: yes` · `Metadata-protocol: semantic` (with a mechanical conversion) · `Skills-docs:` line · Tier H · contract review at the required tier · full verification (`!` major).

## Acceptance

- After conversion, every fixture app's field maps are identical to before; an unconverted set with View All alone no longer reads a field another set hides.
- Gates green; L1 + L2 PASS on the final head; landed by the maintainer's approval.
